findings.chapter: Ch 2 — What Actually Happens During Inference
findings.evidence: "On the canonical 8×H100 host (TP = 8): prefill 1.29 PFLOP / (8 × 0.989 PFLOPS) = 0.16 s at peak, ~0.47 s at 35% MFU [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION — the book's planning MFU, benchmark-informed: the [2°] industry range is 30–40%, and the 35% point is the book's chosen planning value, with 25/35/45% sensitivity in Ch. 8, Table 8-1]"
findings.issue: The label attached to this row is [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION], but the value (0.16 s at peak, ~0.47 s at 35% MFU) is arithmetically derived from the canonical 1.29 PFLOP and the [1P][FACT] H100 peak; per the book's own Axis-2 rule in the Preface ('a value arithmetically derived from those assumed inputs ... is [canonical scenario][DERIVED]'), a computed time from canonical inputs must carry [DERIVED], not [ASSUMPTION]. Ch. 2's own Table 2-2 uses [canonical scenario][DERIVED] for exactly this class of number (e.g. 'Prefill: FLOPs, linear term only ... 1.29 PFLOP ... [canonical scenario][DERIVED]'). The ASSUMPTION/DERIVED split is explicitly the axis the Preface says is 'easy to get wrong' and 'is stated explicitly'.
findings.fix_instruction: Split the label: the 35% MFU planning value is [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION]; the resulting 0.16 s / ~0.47 s prefill times are [canonical scenario][DERIVED]. Keep the MFU provenance in the derivation text and label the row's numeric result DERIVED.

findings.chapter: Ch 2 — What Actually Happens During Inference
findings.evidence: "the capacity question — how many such hosts to absorb λ = 40 rps, where in-flight concurrency λ·W ≈ 344 at the ~8.6 s service time (that occupancy and the canonical 8×H100 host definition are derived in Ch 4 §4.3 and Table 4-2) — is answered later (Ch 16–17)"
findings.issue: This cross-reference points the reader to 'Ch 4 §4.3 and Table 4-2' for the occupancy figure, but Table 4-2's 'Execution occupancy' row is the correct home, while Ch 4 §4.3 is titled 'Worked Example' and the occupancy derivation actually appears in the 'Arithmetic Walk-Through' subsection inside §4.3 (which the chapter does not number as a subsection) — so 'Ch 4 §4.3' does resolve to a section containing the arithmetic, but Table 4-2's occupancy row carries the value '~86 / ~344 requests' with the derivation 'Little's Law L = λ × Wexec'. The reference is therefore technically resolvable. The defect is that Ch 2 cites the occupancy and the 'canonical 8×H100 host definition' as being in Table 4-2, but the canonical host definition (8×H100, 640 GB) appears in Table 4-2's 'Hardware' row while the ~64 GB runtime reserve that the host's KV budget depends on does not appear in Table 4-2 at all — it is introduced in Ch 7 §7.1. A reader following Ch 2's pointer to validate the host definition will find an incomplete ledger.
findings.fix_instruction: Either add the ~64 GB runtime/workspace reserve row to Table 4-2 (labelled [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION], as Ch. 7 §7.1 labels it) so the canonical host definition is complete in the ledger Ch 2 points to, or amend Ch. 2's pointer to cite 'Ch. 4 §4.3, Table 4-2, and Ch. 7 §7.1' for the host definition.

findings.evidence: Ch 2, PDF p.55 (Canonical host verdict): 'The reserve is introduced in Ch 4 and derived in Ch 7.' Contrast Ch 7, PDF p.157: '[canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION] The ~64 GB is a planning reserve, not a measured constant.' and Ch 4, PDF p.116: 'the ~140 GB weights and ~64 GB runtime/workspace [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION] (the runtime/NCCL/activation reserve assumed in Ch 7, which subtracts it to reach the ~436 GB KV budget)'.
findings.issue: Evidence-status contradiction on a load-bearing input: Ch 2 says the ~64 GB runtime/workspace reserve is 'derived in Ch 7', but Ch 7 explicitly carries it as [canonical scenario][ASSUMPTION] ('not a measured constant') and Ch 4 calls it 'assumed in Ch 7'. The reserve is never derived anywhere; Ch 7 only derives the 436 GB KV budget FROM it. DERIVED vs ASSUMPTION is precisely the distinction the book's evidence discipline (Preface; Table 4-2 Note 1) treats as load-bearing, so the Ch 2 wording misstates the reserve's epistemic status.
findings.fix_instruction: In Ch 2's canonical-host-verdict paragraph, replace 'derived in Ch 7' with wording matching the other chapters, e.g. 'introduced in Ch 4 and carried as an [ASSUMPTION] in Ch 7, which uses it to derive the ~436 GB KV budget'.
